zh-Hans: 摆脱了漂移迷思的车手，用抓地跑法才是最快的！
en: A racer who's moved beyond drifting knows grip driving is fastest!

zh-Hans: 终点就在眼前！我一定能守住！
en: The finish is right there! I can hold him off!

zh-Hans: 你也就现在还能得意一会儿！
en: Enjoy it while it lasts!

zh-Hans: 换向真快！
en: He changes direction fast!

zh-Hans: 稍微犯一点错，就会被甩掉！
en: One little mistake, and he'll leave me behind!

zh-Hans: 原来你打定主意，一步都不肯退是吧？！
en: So that's how it is! You're not backing down at all?!

zh-Hans: 前轮响应不对劲，开始推头了！
en: The front tires aren't responding right. It's starting to understeer!

zh-Hans: 让你见识 RB26 的真正实力！
en: I'll show you what the RB26 can really do!

zh-Hans: 越来越难熬了！
en: This is getting tough!

zh-Hans: 全身的血都像沸腾了一样，这股兴奋才叫真正的较量！
en: My blood feels like it's boiling! This rush... this is what a battle should be!

zh-Hans: 我把命都押在这场上了，这一战绝对不能输！
en: I've put my life on this battle! I absolutely cannot lose!

zh-Hans: 可恶！
en: Tch!

zh-Hans: 呜啊！
en: Gah!

zh-Hans: 这混蛋！
en: You bastard!

zh-Hans: 呜，好凌厉！
en: Ugh! What a sharp move!

zh-Hans: 什么？！
en: What?!

zh-Hans: 切，糟了！
en: Tch! I blew it!

zh-Hans: 干得漂亮，不过别以为这样就赢了！
en: Nicely done. But don't think you've won!

zh-Hans: 什、什么？竟然从外侧？！
en: W-what?! Around the outside?!

zh-Hans: 臭小子，别太嚣张！休想从外侧过去！
en: Don't get cocky, you brat! You're not passing me on the outside!

zh-Hans: 糟了，偏偏在关键时候推头了！
en: Damn it! Understeer, right when it mattered most!

zh-Hans: 我绝不会善罢甘休！
en: You're not getting away with this!

zh-Hans: 他到底怎么练出那种技术的？
en: How did he develop that kind of skill?

zh-Hans: 可恶，一点还手之力都没有……这家伙太厉害了！
en: Damn it. I can't even put up a fight... What a driver!

zh-Hans: 光在直道甩掉你，未免太浪费了！
en: It'd be a waste to shake you off on a straight!

zh-Hans: 我要彻底豁出去了！
en: I'm pushing all the way into the danger zone!

zh-Hans: 你跟得上吗？！
en: Can you keep up?!

zh-Hans: 赛道上最强的车，在公路上也是最强！
en: The strongest machine on the circuit is the strongest on the street!

zh-Hans: 内线可不会让！
en: I'm not opening up the inside!

zh-Hans: 我要一路冲到底，看你能跟到哪儿？！
en: I'll keep pushing! How long can you stay with me?!

zh-Hans: 甩不掉！
en: I can't shake him!

zh-Hans: 刹车拖到这么晚，油门也踩了，还是甩不掉？！
en: Even braking this late and getting on the gas, I still can't shake him?!

zh-Hans: 就是这样，就是这种感觉！
en: That's it! That's the feeling!

zh-Hans: 不过如此！
en: Nothing special!

zh-Hans: 好嘞！
en: All right!

zh-Hans: 可别小看我的 R！
en: Don't underestimate my R!

zh-Hans: 你不可能跟得上我！
en: There's no way you can keep up with me!

zh-Hans: 漂移跑法绝对赢不了抓地跑法！
en: Drifting will never beat grip driving!

zh-Hans: 从低挡加速，我比任何车都拿手！
en: No car accelerates out of the low gears better than this!

zh-Hans: 这一瞬间，真让人欲罢不能！
en: I live for moments like this!

zh-Hans: 好嘞！
en: Yeah!

zh-Hans: 热血沸腾了！
en: Now I'm fired up!

zh-Hans: 拿下了！
en: Got you!

zh-Hans: 太慢了！
en: Too slow!

zh-Hans: 人人都把漂移捧上天，我就是看不惯！
en: I'm sick of everyone going on and on about drifting!

zh-Hans: 这可真是辆厉害的车！
en: What an incredible machine!

zh-Hans: 车尾的 R 徽章，就是不败神话的 R！你跟得上我的 R 吗？！
en: The R badge on the rear stands for an undefeated legend! Can you keep up with my R?!

zh-Hans: 我接下了！赌命的较量，正合我意！
en: You're on! A life-or-death battle suits me just fine!
